import { useState } from "react" /* Hooks are special functions, that allows us to use state and other React features in functional component. */ /* useState() Hook is create an "state variable". which help us to track state in component & update the UI when the state changes. */ export default function UseStatePage() { const [counter, setCounter] = useState(0) const [car, setCar] = useState({ brand: "Toyota", model: "Pirus", year: "2010", color: "White", }) const changeCar = (car) => { setCar({ brand: car.brand, model: car.model, year: car.year, color: car.color }) } const changeColor = () => { setCar((prevCar) => { return { ...prevCar, color: "Red", } }) } const [isDarkMode, setIsDarkMode] = useState(false) const bgThemeMode = isDarkMode ? "bg-gray-900" : "bg-white" const textThemeMode = isDarkMode ? "text-white" : "text-black" return (

Counter: {counter}

Car Information

Brand: {car.brand}

Model: {car.model}

Year: {car.year}

Color: {car.color}

Theme Mode

) }
